subject: We have an MSA with Baker Hughes | AI annotation, curation & evaluation
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

We have an MSA in place with Baker Hughes as we work with some of the AI & Computer Vision teams there on use cases such as robotics and automated visual inspection. Thought we could take advantage of the existing legal infrastructure to explore how we might collaborate with your specific team within BH as well.

For context, sophisticated AI/ML teams like Baker Hughes, Fraunhofer or Philips usually come to us when they're at the point of scaling their model training & data pipelines. They mostly use Encord to improve their data curation / annotation and model evaluation processes to iterate on their AI models faster and/or reduce development costs. 

Could be great to chat and get your feedback on what we've built for some of the other Baker Hughes teams. Open to catch up this week? My Thursday's looking pretty open right now.

text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope all's well! I noticed you were expanding your engineering team and
thought I'd reach back out. We've been seeing that many AgTech ML teams are
switching from open-source tools like CVAT to Encord for our comprehensive

model observability.

introduce where Encord tends to fit? Wide open 9-10.30am CST everyday next
week.

subject: Encord - video curation and annotation
text:
Hi [NAME],

I see our teams have been in touch and thought I'd reach back out as I've
been speaking to some of your CV Engineers about some of the inefficiencies
they are facing in the annotation and curation of videos due to having to
work with frames rather than videos natively.

We work with several similar companies such as Standard AI (retail), Voxel
AI (safety) Actuate AI (surveillance) + many others in the venture-backed
video analytics space - helping them build better quality models, faster.
We've helped to boost model development by 700%, achieve 99% label accuracy
and 37X annotation speed.

Given we're the only platform to render video natively it would be great to
speak and see how we can help with some of the problems your team has
been facing. It would be great to discuss where things are headed at Wobots
and potential areas of collaboration. Would you be interested in a call
with our leadership team sometime next week, wide open at 2.30pm
Monday-Friday?

subject: Multimodal ML pipelines
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

Recently read that [COMPANY] has one the largest libraries of Multimodal data in the world, & was curious to understand how you're thinking about managing ML pipelines across different modalities? 

Given the complexities of managing specialised tooling across modalities (whether DICOM, Pdfs or Text) thought it could be relevant to introduce how Encord can help you consolidate your ML pipelines with a single multimodal solution.

Many Engineering Managers at our Radiology AI partners (including Hologic, RapidAI, & Viz.AI) came to us frustrated by the maintenance efforts required to manage in-house tooling for training multimodal AI models at scale.

We built Encord to simplify multimodal data curation & annotation in a single platform, freeing your team from the hassle of internal tool maintenance.

Open to learning more?

Hi [NAME],

Hope all's been well with you - you and Quinn were in touch w/ my
colleagues some time ago I believe?

Congrats on your Series B this past summer. We were really busy raising our
Series B as well.

Anyways, I thought this might be a good time for us to catch up. Since our
last conversation last year, we actually onboarded most gun detection &
safety teams out there (Rhombus, LVT, Flock, Milestone, etc). They usually
came from tools like Labelbox because they didn't live up to their
expectations / were pivoting away from computer vision.

Wouldn't be an understatement to say that we've shaped the product around
the gun detection use case over the last few months. Would love to catch up
and get your thoughts whenever you have some time.

subject: [YEAR] Computer Vision plans
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

I've been following [COMPANY] for some time & curious to understand if Computer Vision is likely to play a greater role in your product development this year? (supporting the brilliant work with RFID) 

Given the complexities I imagine you're tracking in consumer behaviour across retail settings, thought it could be relevant to introduce how Encord can help you capture this complexity in the training data (& improve vs. basic annotation tooling).

Many of the CTOs we work with were frustrated by the architectures of their existing annotation tooling (often CVAT or in-house solutions) limiting their ability to capture rich information from images / videos, as these labelling structures only support one level of depth (i.e. not possible to add attributes).

We built Encord to support dynamic and nested labelling architecture of infinite depth, so you can build richer, and more insightful models, faster.

Open to learning more?

subject: Tomorro <> Encord | Introduction
text:
Hey Sébastien,

J'étais en contact avec Evgeny qui j'ai cru comprendre à récemment quitté
Tomorro.

On avait échangé au sujet d'améliorer la performance de vos modèles d'IA
sur les cas d'usage un peu plus complexes à travers de l'annotation de pdfs
afin de construire un dataset de pour fine tune en plus de Tesseract.

Ce serait cool d'avoir ton feedback sur ce qu'on a construit pour nos
partenaires comme UiPath, Philips, etc dans le domaine. Pour plus de
contexte sur Encord, on a levé $50M de CRV/YC et avons développé une
plateforme de développement de data end to end. On consolide tout ce qui
est data curation, annotation, workflow management et observabilité de
modèles en un outil.

Tu as des dispos la semaine prochaine? Mercredi est plutôt open pour moi.
Si c'est plus simple pour coordonner un créneau - voici mon calendrier
<[LINK]>
.

Au plaisir d'échanger,

text:

I saw that a few senior automation / robotics execs (Kris, Kirk, [SENDER], etc.) including yourself have moved over from Amazon to [COMPANY] in the last year - looks like the team is growing into new use cases (ex: cleaning robots with the OhmniLabs acquisition) on top of the traditional ones like palletization and box-picking.
